test_cases.name: forward_grant_does_not_invent_a_license
test_cases.input: Trace NIH FAIN R01XX000001 forward through papers, patents, ownership, and any license to a product.
assertions: Resolves one seed before searching and does not merge a second graph on a similar name
Puts source, identifier, as_of, and confidence on every hop
Leaves license text unresolved with identifier search:<system> when no public exhibit names the family
Does not treat a missing royalty ledger as zero and does not compute a taxpayer ROI

test_cases.name: reverse_patent_quotes_or_unresolved
test_cases.input: Start from this US patent and say whether public funding contributed.
assertions: Quotes the government-interest clause when it is on the face or a sibling, otherwise marks that hop unresolved
Does not treat a citation to a funded paper as proof this patent was funded
Stops a branch after two consecutive inferred hops and writes the gap

test_cases.name: sbir_is_not_university_bayh_dole
test_cases.input: This firm had an SBIR Phase II and now sells a device. Map the public-return ledger.
assertions: Does not copy university Bayh-Dole title defaults onto the small-business contract
Keeps the embodies edge unresolved until a patent, label, or contract description ties the award to the device
Fills all 14 ledger rows and separates obligation from outlay

test_cases.name: product_page_is_inferred
test_cases.input: The company product page says patented chemistry and does not give a patent number. What can we claim?
assertions: Keeps embodies at inferred, or omits it, and states the missing patent number
Does not promote the product page to an established patent-to-product hop

test_cases.name: refuse_the_verdict
test_cases.input: Tell me if the public got a bad deal on this spinout.
assertions: Refuses a good-deal or bad-deal verdict and refuses a ratio labeled ROI
Offers the public-return ledger as accounting with confidence on each cell
